shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md; echo '---STATUS---'; git status --short; echo '---RECENT---'; git log -3 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts; echo '---MESSAGES TEST---'; sed -n '1,220p' src/types/messages.test.ts; echo '---HANDLER---'; sed -n '1,280p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts; echo '---MESSAGES---'; sed -n '1,220p' src/types/messages.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,90p' package.json; sed -n '1,180p' jest.config.js 2>/dev/null || true; rg -n 'NODE_OPTIONS|experimental-vm|jest' .github package.json README.md | head -60"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npm run spec:names && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add specs src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/types/messages.test.ts && git commit -m "fix: repair conversation list CI findings" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
